race.description: Coonamble Tyre Service/Swanny’s Foods Mdn Plate
race.comment: FRENCH RIVIERA (8) first run for the new yard she caught the eye when fourth over 1100m at Narromine. All the gear comes off for this and should be suited with the fast tempo. Top three contender.  MIND BATTLEFIELD (9) earlier runs for the new stable had merit, then ran below expectations with a battling seventh over 1100m at Narromine. Gets the right set-up today and can return to form quickly. SLEEK 'N' STYLE (13) slow into stride on debut and gave away a big start before running on to secure third over 1000m at Dubbo. Buckley sticks and sure to be in the finish. HOLLYWOOD HUNK (11) three-year-old Showtime gelding from La Bella Rouge on debut for the Brett Robb yard. Wasn't pushed out when fourth in his recent trial over 800m at Narromine. Each way contender. BEST DEFENCE (1) has a fitness edge over most of these and finds an easier race after his sound second at Dubbo.
